github_private_database_markdown_accepta.target: Before every GitHub export, actively read repository metadata, require private=true, then reconcile a deterministic Markdown path through the Contents API using the current content SHA.

mocked_oracle_coverage.public_repository: blocked_policy before any Contents request; export creates a failed receipt with GITHUB_REPOSITORY_NOT_PRIVATE and no binding.
mocked_oracle_coverage.first_export: GET repository metadata, GET deterministic Contents path, then PUT Markdown; returned content SHA, commit SHA and exact returned path are required before binding/receipt confirmation.
mocked_oracle_coverage.unchanged_projection: GET repository metadata and current Contents SHA, return noop, refresh binding and create a noop receipt without PUT.
mocked_oracle_coverage.remote_drift: A changed remote SHA is repaired with that current SHA in the PUT payload rather than trusting the old local binding.

github_private_database_markdown_accepta.binding_and_receipt: Done and noop outcomes upsert the deterministic binding and create matching receipts. Failure creates a failed receipt with the provider error code and retains no invented remote identity.
github_private_database_markdown_accepta.blocking_result: The frozen SA-401 command passed 12/12. The additional Stage 0/4, capture, replication and storage regression command passed 8/8.

private_database_boundary_correction.defect_found: The pre-existing local writer and sync script treated a checked-out Private-Database clone as a durable transport and could Git commit/push it. That conflicts with the repository-wide no-clone Private-Database boundary.
private_database_boundary_correction.repair: ArchiveService no longer writes a second local Private-Database copy. The retained legacy writer and sync entry point now fail closed before writing, cloning, committing or pushing.
private_database_boundary_correction.scope_boundary: This is a safety disablement, not a claim that structured-fact durable synchronization is complete. SA-504 remains solely responsible for the compliant official Private-Database API-client transport and cold backup.

related_regression.warning: One existing Starlette TestClient deprecation warning; no assertion failure.

semantic_reconciliation.reason: The frozen GitHub destination was preserved where valid and adapted only to remove the local-binding bypass, add remote Contents reconciliation, bind the fixed Private-Database identity/area, and fail close the prohibited local clone path.

execution_corrections: The first added Mock assertion used a non-ASCII bytes literal and failed during test collection. It was immediately corrected to UTF-8 encoding; the final frozen command and related regression both passed.
A macOS locale failure prevented shasum from producing source hashes. Read-only Python hashlib was used instead; no source or runtime data was changed by the hash retry.

source_change.product_source_rewrite: No broad rewrite. The existing single transaction/recovery core remains intact; this is a narrow GitHub destination reconciliation and Private-Database boundary repair.

scope_exclusions: No real GitHub account, credential, repository metadata, Contents API, Private-Database API, user content, provider network request, cloud action, Docker image/build/service, deployment, Git staging, commit, push, merge, rebase, new worktree, legacy ignored-runtime access, or destructive cleanup occurred.
All provider behavior was exercised only through in-process httpx.MockTransport and pytest temporary 0600 fake secrets. Fixture PASS does not prove a real repository or owner authorization.
Real GitHub Private-Database metadata/read/write canary is NOT_RUN because no Owner credential or real remote action was authorized.
